name: Cloudreve Fork
description: Cloudreve Fork v4.23.0 is the Dvorinka open-source Cloudreve server. It uses the same Postgres and Redis layout as upstream and is not the official paid Pro image.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  cloudreve-pro:
    image: ghcr.io/dvorinka/cloudreve:v4.23.0@sha256:75b6e6f1781e37b47320907d6f72476e19cd85c5ef073579e441e01d0509c4c5
    container_name: cloudreve-pro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_started
      redis:
        condition: service_started
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:5212"
    environment:
      CR_CONF_Database.Type: postgres
      CR_CONF_Database.Host: postgresql
      CR_CONF_Database.User: cloudreve
      CR_CONF_Database.Name: cloudreve
      CR_CONF_Database.Port: "5432"
      CR_CONF_Redis.Server: redis:6379
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/cloudreve/data
  postgresql:
    image: postgres:17@sha256:d74eeac9a635390a49bc21bd49fccd973de707e2a53a76ac49b552b8712ec46f
    container_name: cloudreve-pro-postgresql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: cloudreve
      POSTGRES_DB: cloudreve
      POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  redis:
    image: redis:8.10.2@sha256:6f81e8915c60b065a524e6967e0ad1c639ba6efa84d669f823683ea04d9150ee
    container_name: cloudreve-pro-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/redis:/data
